gaps.detail: Approved live image provider/model revisions still need NODE-23-backed benchmark evidence for Chinese poster text, product/logo consistency, brand style, multiple aspect ratios, transparent output, latency, cost and fallback.
Real provider-output fetching and durable object-store adapters still need SSRF/redirect policy, signed-URL expiry handling, streaming size limits, content scanning, cleanup and operational evidence.
The 202 submit/worker contract is implemented, but durable NODE-19 consumers, webhook/poll scheduling, retry/backoff, DLQ and reconciliation are not yet wired to production infrastructure.
Fail-closed postflight seams exist, but production raster/OCR observations and calibrated NODE-39 constraint, NODE-43 brand and NODE-44 identity delegates still need real image evidence.

Migration, concurrent idempotency/pending recovery, NODE-42 Artifact creation and NODE-27 cost projection require live PostgreSQL/load evidence; paid provider accepted-error monetary reconciliation at the NODE-22/27 boundary must also be proven fail-safe.
